CommunityApplications.Profile:
The XKNX project maintains the XKNX Editor, a KNX project editor built on the open-source xknx library. This repository provides its browser UI as a container: open, edit and export KNX projects, browse the product catalog and program KNX devices over a KNXnet/IP interface.
Report problems and ask questions in the [GitHub issues](https://github.com/XKNX/xknx-editor/issues).
